module: Module 6: Independent Sub-Account Margin, Leverage & Stop-Outs
title: Dynamic Leverage Reduction on High-Impact Economic News
precondition: Broker automatically reduces leverage from 1:500 to 1:100 during NFP release.
expected: Sizing engine recalculates available group margin; prevents opening oversized orders under reduced leverage.
coverage_note: Requires configured stop-out/leverage/news/swap/notification fixtures beyond the verified account margin cases.
